_comment: Shared cross-language pin for the IFC2X3 OwnerHistory fill (#4686). Each case is a whole DATA section exported with schema IFC2X3 by both STEP exporters: rust/export/src/schema_convert_tests.rs (export_step_with_stats) and packages/export/src/schema-converter-owner-history.test.ts (StepExporter). `owner_history` maps an express id to the value its slot 1 (OwnerHistory) must hold in the output; `unfilled` is how many records the export had to leave with $ there. Only slot 1 is compared: the two converters differ elsewhere (proxy GlobalIds, resource-entity trims), and that is not what this pins.

cases.why: a $ OwnerHistory takes the FIRST owner history in the file; a record naming its own keeps it; a non-rooted record is not touched
no owner history in the file: nothing is invented, the slot stays $ and every rooted record left that way is counted
the converter's own IFCPROXY placeholder is an IfcRoot record, so its OwnerHistory is filled too
an IFCPROXY placeholder with no owner history to point at keeps $ and is counted
IfcDoorType becomes IfcDoorStyle through the by-name remap, not the positional trim, and is filled all the same
